cardOverview.overviewText: A lifestyle card from CSB Bank that rewards shopping, dining, and travel spends with flexible redemption options and milestone benefits.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.howToAvail: Call the number given on the back of your card.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Personal Accident and Total Permanent Disability Cover up to ₹10 lakhs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to CSB Bank Customer Care at 1800 266 9090 or email customercare@csb.co.in. For assistance via the Jupiter app, contact edge-csb-support@jupiter.money or call +91 86550 55086.
